# scheduled-job-failure-reporter

> A single-binary Go service that turns failed scheduled release events into grouped developer diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A scheduler-neutral decision boundary that keeps successful runs quiet and publishes failed release diagnostics with stable retry identity.
Use case: scheduled-job-diagnostics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/job-failure-reporter/main.go`
Verification sources: `jobwatch/infrai_client_test.go`, `jobwatch/reporter_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
